summary.text:
Global equities diverged as US indices retreated, led lower by the Russell 2000 falling 1.66% and the S&P 500 shedding 0.35%, while the VIX jumped 6.92% to 18.7. Sentiment was weighed down by a 4.34% drop in Nvidia to 166.19 and a 7.33% slide in Bitcoin to 68541.8828. Conversely, European bourses gained, with the DAX rising 0.41% and the CAC adding 0.34%.

In currencies and commodities, the dollar index hovered at 103.176, as EURUSD declined 0.32% to 1.1059 and GBPUSD slipped 0.39% to 1.3225, while USDJPY gained 0.13% to 159.941. Gold advanced 0.81% to 3916.8. Oil softened, with WTI crude down 0.61% to 88.2 and Brent down 0.24% to 95.59.

Market participants are watching the vVARDIS NYSE initial public offering priced at 18.00 dollars per share, RedCloud's 100-for-1 share consolidation on Tuesday, and proposals being studied for a strategic gas reserve to anticipate future crises.
